Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Host API quickstart request received – BrightLayer

Hi Logan,

Thanks for signing up to evaluate Redwood Hosted API. We received BrightLayer's request for a quickstart walkthrough. To help us prepare, could you confirm the primary evaluation goal (POC, latency/cost benchmark, or production pilot) and any compliance concerns?

You can also book a 30-minute quickstart slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-quickstart

Best,
Redwood Hosted API Team

Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for signing up and for the details in the intake. I’m Logan, the SDR covering BrightLayer; Ava (cc) is the solutions AE who will join the walkthrough. Quick answers so we can get you booked:

- Primary goal: understand Hosted API latency at 1k qps and run a short evaluation of cost/throughput vs. your current provider.
- Compliance: you noted SOC 2 concerns; we’ll touch on data handling and customer isolation briefly and can loop in Security if needed.

I have a few windows this week and next — feel free to pick any slot that works: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/30min-quickstart
Or, if you prefer, here are options (all in PDT):
- Tue 5/5 10:00–10:30
- Wed 5/6 14:00–14:30
- Thu 5/7 11:30–12:00

If those don’t fit, tell me your timezone and a preferred block and I’ll work around it. I’ll send a short agenda PDF once we lock a time.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
SDR, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

1) Quick account setup and where to find your free evaluation credits
2) Targeted throughput/latency tests (recommended payloads and sequence lengths)
3) Suggested batching and caching knobs to hit cost targets
